title: Filipino Honeyed Custard Toast
description: A sweet and savory breakfast toast made with honeyed custard and topped with a caramelized jam.
instructions: 1. Toast the bread until lightly browned.
2. Spread the butter on the toasted bread.
3. Top the butter with a layer of honeyed custard.
4. Drizzle the jam on top of the custard.
5. Caramelize the jam by placing the toast under the broiler for 2-3 minutes.
6. Remove the toast from the oven and let it cool for a minute.
7. Serve the toast warm and enjoy!
